releaseNotes:
MY Watchlist 0.4.3 (11)

Restores the accepted Premium TV UI before the last responsive/scaling pass.
Adds optional startup updates and a Settings update check, download verification and Android-confirmed installation.

Bootstrap build: install this APK over the existing app once to enable future in-app updates. This release preserves the existing Android debug signing identity; a production release signing configuration has not been introduced.
